verdict.rationale: Missive can be driven without its UI through a documented REST API and webhooks. The API has a per-endpoint reference against public.missiveapp.com/v1, documented rate limits with 429/Retry-After handling, drafts creatable via the API and an MCP server, and server-side rules. That supports scripted, headless automation, but nothing shows a CLI, CI integration, or a guide to running it in pipelines. Missing for 10: an official CLI or headless runner, CI/pipeline docs or examples, documented service-account/token setup for non-interactive use, an OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.
